name: @rb/site
description: Storefront — a modular website engine for barber shops, restaurants, retail stores, wedding halls and gyms, with a private order desk on its own subdomain.
//deps: Deliberately depends on no @rb/* workspace package. The standalone build is produced by copying this directory out of the monorepo, and a workspace import would make that copy fail to install. The handful of helpers that would otherwise be shared live in src/lib.

scripts.//vend: Produce the licence-free standalone copy that is sold outright. Run from the repo root as `npm run vend:standalone`.
scripts.//check:data: Run the repositories against pglite — a real Postgres in-process. Proves the things a typecheck cannot: that cancelling an order puts the stock back, that two customers cannot take the same slot, and that the reports see what was sold.
